thesis: AMPH is a post-earnings uptrend consolidating on its SMA20, with accelerating revenue and sharply higher net income, and it sits in a health-care name while the regime view says XLV is leading. A pullback entry near the SMA20 gives a defined stop under the 10-day swing low, and 21.5% short interest adds squeeze fuel if the market eases. The setup is still modest and not high-conviction. Reward/risk is only about 1.76, there is no fresh catalyst, the price is above the mean analyst target, and the regime is risk-off with thin half-day liquidity. This supports a small, patient pullback entry at most, not an aggressive long.
